title: responsiveness
category: sub-skill of image-to-react · viewports & reflow loop
short_summary: evaluates one shared responsive react dom across desktop, mobile, and six viewports (320px to 1536px) before designer critique.
when_to_use: use in jason-dev-agent when building, tuning, or verifying responsive layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.
summary: Reflows and evaluates a single unified Golden Template React build across desktop, mobile, and a 6-viewport continuum (320px, 375px, mobile @2x CSS width, 768px, 1024px, and desktop CSS width) without vertical squashing or duplicate desktop/mobile DOM trees. Runs an iterative self-judging responsiveness dev eval loop until all viewport gates pass, then hands the same stage back into jason-design-agent via design-critique for a designer critique against the original inspiration. Use whenever building, tuning, or verifying responsive layouts across viewports. Don't use for single-image pixel cropping alone (use replicate-mock) or font ranking (use google-font-selection).
